title: All structure maps of a hypercovering are coverings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Show K_n -> X and every face map d_i^n : K_n -> K_{n-1} is a covering: (1) follows from (2) because the composition K_n -> K_{n-1} -> ... -> K_0 -> {X->X} is a covering by lemma-covering-permanence, and K_0 -> {X->X} is a covering by definition; for (2), Mor(Delta[n],K)_0 = K_n (simplicial-lemma-exists-hom-from-simplicial-set-finite), so each d_i^n is the map Hom(Delta[n],K)_0 -> Hom(Delta[n-1],K)_0 attached to the inclusion Delta[n-1] -> Delta[n], and lemma-add-simplices applied to the n+1 inclusions gives the covering property.
